notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, as we mentioned earlier, we’re releasing the first update with improvements, graphical fixes, and a reorganization of the dressing room.
Changelog:
🎨 Fixed coloring issues that caused strange tints.
👠 High heels are now compatible with most outfits.
👗 Dresses have been separated as unique items.
🔀 Eight outfits have been split into two parts to allow mix-and-match.
💎 Necklaces removed from outfits (they will become a separate category).
🌀 Fixed animation errors.
🚬 All compatible animations now include the smoking layer if enabled.
🔓 Removed restrictions in certain scenes.
💄 Coming soon: new makeup variations.



We’ll continue expanding the variety of options and fixing the most noticeable issues.

Thank you for your support! ❤️

notes.title: Pre-release Info
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/3a3ccfe75439387f87e23a1140384c1632d18879.png"]

Hello! This is the first time we’re posting something like this here. We’ll try not to make it too long, but it’s good to share a few important details. We hadn’t done it before because we’ve been busy refining the current version of the game.

For now, the game is available in two languages: English and Spanish. (Both manually translated, so if you find any errors or small details we might have missed, please let us know!)

Our plan is to translate it into more languages during development. We already have a Chinese translator, and we’re currently in talks with a few Russian translators—though of course, that will depend on the level of interest we see.

At this stage, the game is divided into two parts. The goal is to showcase the overall intention we have for each character, as well as the level of depth you can expect from them. Think of it as a very detailed tutorial... if you know what I mean.

The game also includes some tips inside the menu, in the “Help” section, which are especially useful for the more advanced stages of this build. (It also comes with built-in auto-play.)
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/f2d607d7ae0451a46a52f8451cd7debc701371ce.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/8d6018ad06928ac9b8c4c59312f3012ec2fc0116.png"][/carousel]
There’s also a pretty complete replay gallery that contains all the initial scenes, many of which are customizable. This represents about 30% of the total game scenes at the moment. For the final section of this version, we still need to adapt some of the customization features.


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/70b36306175bd7c734bb9fcb677df2ad93ecabe8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/5064208eb929b52792dace02800b497e68e58777.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/791537deff912eeb784e09fcebb8ad96f6ef9ef6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/cff9d5b7091c47776b055fe5e07d427053fe8f73.png"][/carousel]

The vast majority of content is in the latter part of the game.

There’s an unlock-all button—feel free to use it! Just keep in mind that it won’t unlock the customizable parts. Some scenes don’t yet have all their dialogues completed (in the gallery), but we’re working on that.

Throughout the game, there are unlockables and an early affection system. Choices highlighted in colors usually mean unlocking content (scenes, outfits, hairstyles) or progressing further in the story.


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/0f95b69ab6c909f0a4c3f1cfaf1a489f8246b33c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/2bbcb621b3533885f724ce92d6aa227532ac553f.png"][/carousel]
By the time you’re reading this, we’ll already be working on the next stage of development. But don’t hesitate to ask questions, share your feedback, or let us know any concerns!

This project has been entirely handcrafted, and since the very first version it has only grown and improved. We hope to keep it that way!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446010/0eb8f132626e7e6ec4fb1e5a6339ef2732cc5ddd.png"]

notes.title: Trophies: A Corruption Tale Release Date!
notes.notes:
Finally, after a lot of hard work, we’re launching Trophies: A Corruption Tale in Early Access on August 25th.

This marks the beginning of a new chapter for this project, and we’re really excited about it. We’ve worked hard and will continue doing so to bring you the best experience.

Dive into a story of corruption, desire, and lust, with characters as intriguing as they are unhinged. Love? Corruption? Is there really a difference here?



Enjoy a high level of customization, with options for clothing, high heels, hairstyles, makeup, accessories, and more.



Don’t forget to add Trophies: A Corruption Tale to your wishlist.

For questions, feedback, or suggestions, please use the community forum or our Discord.
